messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: routing-service detected elevated error rate for rollout_id=rl_87a2; spike in "fallback" events to variant=legacy-1 in eu-west-1 — 12% -> 48% over 6m. Pager triggered for infra/oncall.

sam-sre: Taking pager. Looking at metrics now. Can someone drop the recent rollout id?

marta-eng: that's rl_87a2 — staged rollout started 09:50 UTC, 10% traffic, sticky routing enabled (session_affinity=true).

sam-sre: Ok. I see error budget burn and a lot of short lived 5xx from model-proxy when requests hit legacy-1. Latency also up ~300ms median.

alice.ops: @sam-sre I'm on-call handoff in 10m; if you need me earlier I can jump.

sam-sre: please standby, might need escalation.

ethan-rep: Customer support is seeing a few feature flags flipped; some customers report garbled outputs and hallucinations. Logged as INC-4312. Not many but paying customers hit by routed legacy model.

marta-eng: That fits: rollout had a variant compatibility mismatch. The new variant requires a tokenizer update; fallback policy is sticky to previous variant if new fails — but sticky fallback seems to be forcing subsequent requests from the same session to legacy-1 even after stash expired.

ken-devex: Reproduced locally: when new-llama v2 fails early in handshake, router sets session_route=legacy-1 and there's a bug where sticky TTL isn't refreshed properly.

sam-sre: Can we pause the rollout and clear sticky entries for rl_87a2?

marta-eng: Initiating pause (API call).

marta-eng: Command: ```
> curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/rollouts/rl_87a2/pause -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTL"
```

incidents-bot: action taken: rollout rl_87a2 paused by marta-eng at 1845001500.

sam-sre: Good. Now we need to clear problematic sticky routes in the routing cache for eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Who can run the cache sweep?

ken-devex: Running sweep now with dry-run first. Command: ```
> ./tools/route-cleaner --region eu-west-1 --rollout rl_87a2 --dry-run
```

ken-devex: Dry-run shows ~18k sessions would be rewritten to stable-2. Proceeding to actual run in 30s.

ken-devex: Running: ```
> ./tools/route-cleaner --region eu-west-1 --rollout rl_87a2
```

incidents-bot: route-cleaner reported 17,842 sticky entries removed in eu-west-1 at 1845001762.

sam-sre: Rolling through eu-central-1 next.

ken-devex: eu-central done, 9,410 entries removed.

sam-sre: Monitoring errors/latency. Also setting temporary policy override to disable sticky fallbacks for this rollout to avoid oscillation.

marta-eng: Patch ready for router: change is_simple_sticky = false -> true only when variant_compatibility=true. Applying hotfix to routing-service config via k8s patch.

marta-eng: Patch applied: ```
kubectl -n routing patch cm policy-config --patch '{"data":{"sticky_behavior":"compat_only"}}'
```

incidents-bot: Deploy job started for routing-service config at 1845002065. CI passed.

sam-sre: After cache sweep + patch I see errors drop from 48% -> 6% in 6m. Latency trending down.

ethan-rep: Notifying impacted customers in INC-4312: initial message sent, we included mitigation steps and ETA for full verification.

alice.ops: On-call handoff: @oncall-night I'm going to hand this over in 20m. All runbooks executed except long tail verification.

oncall-night: Acknowledged — I'll own overnight verification. Please push the list of checks.

sam-sre: Checks for handoff: 1) error_rate < 1% for 15m; 2) median latency within 10% of baseline; 3) no new sticky fallback spikes in routing metrics; 4) key customer sampling shows sane outputs.

marta-eng: Additional followup: create PR to add variant_compatibility flag to rollout creation UI and block sticky fallback unless set. I'll file RFC.

ken-devex: Also adding a periodic TTL refresher audit to route-cleaner so stale session entries are visible in metrics.

sam-sre: Marking incident as mitigated for paging. We'll keep thread open until next sync. Great work team. :tada:

incidents-bot: incident mitigated (paging cleared) at 1845003200 — followup runbook created: RH-2026-routing-sticky-fallback.

marta-eng: Postmortem owners: marta-eng (root cause + fix), ken-devex (tooling), sam-sre (mitigation steps), alice.ops (customer comms). Target postmortem draft by EOD +2.

ethan-rep: Support note: list of impacted customers attached to INC-4312. Suggest outreach to top 3 customers for apology + credits.

oncall-night: Took handoff at 1845003600. Will run checks overnight and report by 08:00 UTC.

sam-sre: Thanks. Closing paging but keeping channel for followups.

marta-eng: Quick snippet from routing logs during failure window (sanitized):
```
[1845001602] route-check: session_id=abcd token_ok=false variant=new-llama handshake_err=tokenizer_mismatch -> fallback=legacy-1 sticky_set=true ttl=86400
[1845001611] route-check: session_id=abcd token_ok=false variant=legacy-1 success=true
[1845001620] route-check: session_id=abcde token_ok=false variant=new-llama handshake_err=timeout -> fallback=legacy-1 sticky_set=true ttl=86400
[1845001635] route-check: session_id=abcde later_request variant=new-llama routed=legacy-1 sticky=true
```

sam-sre: That log shows the TTL was set to 86400 and never honored by refresher; hence the sticky persisted beyond intended short-term fallback. Fixing TTL semantics in policy is part of the postmortem.

ken-devex: Filed GH issue #1187 for TTL semantics + added unit tests.

marta-eng: Will add a rollout-time validation step to block creating a rollout when tokenizer/schema mismatch is detected by preflight checks.

ethan-rep: Customer-facing summary drafted and shared with legal for review.

sam-sre: Final note — no data exfil, impact limited to quality/regression for affected customers. Moving to incident -> remediation phase.

incidents-bot: thread archived for paging at 1845004822)"
